in_hebrew.name: ברא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name 'Barra' is derived from the Hebrew word 'ברא' (bara), which means 'Creator'. In the Bible, this name is associated with God, the creator of the universe.

in_greek.name: Βαρρα
in_greek.long_meaning: There is no clear Greek equivalent for the name 'Barra'. However, the name 'Barrabas' (Βαρραβας) appears in the New Testament, which may be derived from the Hebrew 'ברא' (bara) and means 'son of the father' or 'son of the creator'.

in_latin.name: Barrus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name 'Barrus' in Latin is derived from the Hebrew 'ברא' (bara) and means 'son of the father' or 'son of the creator'. It is a common name in the Roman world, particularly among the patrician class.
